title: Continuum Backup Deprovisioning Charge on Cancelled Microsoft 365 Subscriptions
content:
**Charge clause.** Stratton Bay deducts a backup deprovisioning charge from a Microsoft 365 Cloud Subscriptions (CSP) cancellation refund for each Microsoft 365 user taken off the client's active Continuum Backup & Recovery plan.

**Users taken off.** The number is the lesser of two figures:

- the licenses cancelled;
- that plan's own protected Microsoft 365 users, which are its protections of Microsoft 365 users less its own removals of them.

**Rate per user taken off.**

- **0.50 USD** under an active Continuum Backup Plus, Continuum BDR, Continuum DRaaS or Continuum DRaaS Premier plan;
- **1.00 USD** under an active Continuum Backup Basic or Continuum Backup Standard plan;
- **nothing** without an active Continuum plan, or where that plan protects no Microsoft 365 user.

**Records read.**

- The plan's tier and status come from the client's Continuum Backup & Recovery plan record.
- The protections and removals come from that plan's own device changes whose device class is Microsoft 365 user. Records of any other Continuum plan of the client are not read.

## Rate table

| Active Continuum Backup & Recovery tier | Protects at least one Microsoft 365 user | Charge per user taken off |
|---|---|---|
| Continuum Backup Basic | yes | 1.00 USD |
| Continuum Backup Standard | yes | 1.00 USD |
| Continuum Backup Plus | yes | 0.50 USD |
| Continuum BDR | yes | 0.50 USD |
| Continuum DRaaS | yes | 0.50 USD |
| Continuum DRaaS Premier | yes | 0.50 USD |
| any tier | no | nothing |
| no active plan | — | nothing |

## Hypothetical illustrations

- 30 licenses are cancelled, and the active Continuum BDR plan protects 18 Microsoft 365 users (20 protections less 2 removals). 18 users are taken off at 0.50, so 9.00 USD is deducted.
- Under an active Continuum Backup Standard plan protecting 40 users, 30 users are taken off at 1.00, so 30.00 USD is deducted.
- An active Continuum BDR plan protecting only servers takes nothing.
